limitations: Offline original-program rendering with MAME-derived 6800 instruction semantics and total cycles. Individual DAC writes are timestamped at instruction completion, not individual bus phase.

Raw held DAC output uses the reference renderer 0.25 gain and per-sample box integration. No cabinet speaker response, analogue amplifier response, added EQ, fade, per-clip normalization or invented sounds.
Each isolated command/event starts from reset with initially zero RAM. Some generator history/noise may vary in live sequences; event WAVs preserve state within their scheduled sequence.
A capture cutoff is not a loop point. Any command still active at cutoff must not be blindly looped. Raw traces and renderer permit longer captures.
Command 00 is no new trigger; command3f interrupts synthesis without changing the last DAC level. Neither is an audible asset.
